```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Purpose: Sophie wants to test differential expression between developmental
stages (e11 vs e12) directly, despite stage being perfectly confounded with
sequencing batch in this dataset (see `RScripts/20261021_archive/README.md`
for the full discussion). This can't be fully resolved from the data alone,
but two concrete steps make the comparison more defensible than a plain,
unadjusted test:

1. Re-run the existing control-only stage comparisons from
   `07-de.control.timepoint.Rmd` (`ident.1 = "{celltype}_e11_control"`,
   `ident.2 = "{celltype}_e12_control"`, same object, same pEGFP-1 fix,
   same control-only restriction - genotype is deliberately excluded so it
   doesn't become a second confound on top of stage/batch) both the
   original way (plain Wilcoxon) and with known technical covariates
   (`percent.mt`, `percent.ribo`, `percent.hb`, `nCount_RNA`) included as
   `latent.vars` in a logistic-regression test, so the stage effect is
   estimated net of those specific, measured technical proxies.

2. A housekeeping-gene diagnostic: a 15-gene panel of broadly-used mouse
   reference genes (NOT independently re-validated as stage-invariant in
   this specific E11.5-E12.5 heart dataset - treat this as the standard/
   generic choice it is), checked for an e11-vs-e12 shift within each cell
   type (control cells only). Since these genes aren't expected to change
   for developmental reasons, any shift observed estimates how large the
   "pure technical" floor might be, to calibrate against the DE results.

**Standalone fork** - does not modify `07-de.control.timepoint.Rmd` or any
other existing script/object.

# Clean-up environment

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects includuing hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
set.seed(42) # set seed for reproducibility
```

# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
```

# Set project directories and file paths

```{r}
project_repo_dir <- "/home/melanie-smith/workDir/sophieWiszniak/20251104_sophieWiszniak_ncc_pa"
data_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir", "06-cluster_marker_genes")
out_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "stage_de_housekeeping_fork")

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# Load required object
- Same object and pEGFP-1 fix as `07-de.control.timepoint.Rmd`.

```{r}
re_embed_interesting_cells <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds"))
stopifnot(inherits(re_embed_interesting_cells, "Seurat"))

stopifnot("pEGFP-1" %in% rownames(re_embed_interesting_cells))
message("Dimensions before removing pEGFP-1: ", paste(dim(re_embed_interesting_cells), collapse = " x "))
re_embed_interesting_cells <- subset(
  re_embed_interesting_cells,
  features = setdiff(rownames(re_embed_interesting_cells), "pEGFP-1")
)
message("Dimensions after removing pEGFP-1: ", paste(dim(re_embed_interesting_cells), collapse = " x "))
stopifnot(!("pEGFP-1" %in% rownames(re_embed_interesting_cells)))

# composite identity, same construction as 07-de.control.timepoint.Rmd
re_embed_interesting_cells$celltype.cond <- paste(
  re_embed_interesting_cells$new_celltypes,
  re_embed_interesting_cells$orig.ident,
  sep = "_"
)
Idents(re_embed_interesting_cells) <- "celltype.cond"

celltypes <- c("Mesenchyme", "Myocardium", "Endocardium", "Epicardium", "VSMC")
technical_covariates <- c("percent.mt", "percent.ribo", "percent.hb", "nCount_RNA")
```

# =============================================================================
# Part 1: Stage DE (control-only), plain Wilcoxon vs covariate-adjusted LR
# =============================================================================

```{r stage-de-loop, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
wilcox_results <- list()
lr_results     <- list()

for (ct in celltypes) {

  message(glue::glue("--- {ct} ---"))

  ident.1 <- paste0(ct, "_e11_control")
  ident.2 <- paste0(ct, "_e12_control")

  wilcox_results[[ct]] <- FindMarkers(
    re_embed_interesting_cells,
    ident.1  = ident.1,
    ident.2  = ident.2,
    test.use = "wilcox",
    verbose  = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cell_type = ct)

  lr_results[[ct]] <- FindMarkers(
    re_embed_interesting_cells,
    ident.1     = ident.1,
    ident.2     = ident.2,
    test.use    = "LR",
    latent.vars = technical_covariates,
    verbose     = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cell_type = ct)

  write_csv(wilcox_results[[ct]], file.path(out_dir, paste0("07-", ct, "_e11_vs_e12_control_wilcoxon.csv")))
  write_csv(lr_results[[ct]],     file.path(out_dir, paste0("07-", ct, "_e11_vs_e12_control_LR_covariate_adjusted.csv")))
}
```

## Summary: how much does covariate adjustment change the DE gene count

```{r stage-de-summary}
padj_thresh <- 0.05
lfc_thresh  <- 0.25

summarise_de <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < padj_thresh, abs(avg_log2FC) > lfc_thresh) %>%
    nrow()
}

de_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  cell_type         = celltypes,
  n_sig_wilcoxon    = purrr::map_int(celltypes, ~ summarise_de(wilcox_results[[.x]])),
  n_sig_LR_adjusted = purrr::map_int(celltypes, ~ summarise_de(lr_results[[.x]]))
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_retained = round(100 * n_sig_LR_adjusted / n_sig_wilcoxon, 1)
  )

de_summary

write_csv(de_summary, file.path(out_dir, "07-stage_de_wilcoxon_vs_LR_adjusted_summary.csv"))
```

## Which genes drop out after adjustment (per cell type)

- Genes significant in the plain Wilcoxon test but not after adjusting for
  the technical covariates - these are the genes whose apparent stage
  effect is most consistent with being driven by the measured technical
  proxies rather than surviving independently of them.

```{r stage-de-dropped-genes}
dropped_genes <- purrr::map_dfr(celltypes, function(ct) {
  wilcox_sig <- wilcox_results[[ct]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < padj_thresh, abs(avg_log2FC) > lfc_thresh) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  lr_sig <- lr_results[[ct]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < padj_thresh, abs(avg_log2FC) > lfc_thresh) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  tibble::tibble(
    cell_type = ct,
    gene      = setdiff(wilcox_sig, lr_sig)
  )
})

dropped_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(cell_type, name = "n_genes_dropped_after_adjustment")

write_csv(dropped_genes, file.path(out_dir, "07-stage_de_genes_dropped_after_adjustment.csv"))
```

# =============================================================================
# Part 2: Housekeeping gene diagnostic (control cells only)
# =============================================================================

- Standard mouse reference-gene panel, not independently validated as
  stage-invariant for this tissue/window - treat as a generic diagnostic,
  not a ground truth.

```{r housekeeping-setup}
hk_panel <- c("Actb", "Gapdh", "B2m", "Hprt", "Tbp", "Ppia", "Ywhaz", "Sdha",
              "Rpl13a", "Pgk1", "Hmbs", "Tuba1a", "Rplp0", "Gusb", "Polr2a")

stopifnot(all(hk_panel %in% rownames(re_embed_interesting_cells)))

control_cells <- subset(re_embed_interesting_cells, subset = genotype == "control")

hk_expr <- GetAssayData(control_cells, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[hk_panel, ]
control_cells$hk_score <- Matrix::colMeans(hk_expr)
```

```{r housekeeping-test, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
hk_summary <- control_cells@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(new_celltypes %in% celltypes) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(new_celltypes, stage) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells      = dplyr::n(),
    mean_hk_score = mean(hk_score),
    median_hk_score = median(hk_score),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hk_summary

hk_test <- purrr::map_dfr(celltypes, function(ct) {
  sub_meta <- control_cells@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(new_celltypes == ct)

  wt <- wilcox.test(hk_score ~ stage, data = sub_meta)

  e11_mean <- mean(sub_meta$hk_score[sub_meta$stage == "e11"])
  e12_mean <- mean(sub_meta$hk_score[sub_meta$stage == "e12"])

  tibble::tibble(
    cell_type   = ct,
    e11_mean_hk = e11_mean,
    e12_mean_hk = e12_mean,
    diff_e11_minus_e12 = e11_mean - e12_mean,
    wilcoxon_p  = wt$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(wilcoxon_p, method = "BH"))

hk_test

write_csv(hk_test, file.path(out_dir, "07-housekeeping_stage_shift_summary.csv"))
```

## Visualise

```{r housekeeping-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
hk_plot <- control_cells@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(new_celltypes %in% celltypes) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = new_celltypes, y = hk_score, fill = stage)) +
  geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Housekeeping panel score, control cells only, e11 vs e12",
    subtitle = "Mean log-normalised expression across a 15-gene reference panel",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Housekeeping panel score"
  )

hk_plot

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "07-housekeeping_stage_shift_violin.png"),
  plot = hk_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
